title: Sally, John, and Darren's New Year Plans
shared_passage:
Listen to three people talking about what they are going to do differently in the new year and answer the questions.

SALLY: I put on weight last year when I had my kids, and I want to lose it. But I don't want to stop eating unhealthy food. I like cakes and chocolate too much! So, I'm going to join a gym. It's expensive, but if I pay for it, I will go. There are parent and baby swim classes every morning, and I want to go to all of those. I hope I can meet people there. I don't have many friends now because I quit my job and I'm with the kids all day. I'd love to take a class at the college, like photography, but I can't now. The kids need me. Maybe I will next year.

JOHN: Well, last year, I decided to do more exercise, so I started cycling. But I fell off after one month and hurt my back. So I'm not going to do that again! But I want to lose weight, so I'm going to stop eating burgers and eat more vegetables. I'm also going to go swimming at the sports center twice a week. My wife swims every day, but I don't want to do that because I want to work in the garden too. That will take a lot of time and keep me fit. I also want to spend more time with my friends. My kids are older now, so they don't need me at home.

DARREN: I got a new bike for Christmas, and I plan to use it. I want to go a hundred miles each week on it. I also want to join the photography classes at the local college. Then I can take some great pictures when I'm out on my rides. And I'm going to spend more time with my kids. Last year, I spent a lot of time driving to work, so I didn't see them in the mornings or evenings. But now I have a new job and I work from home, so I can be here for them. We can do fun things like making cakes and playing in the garden. It will be fun!

questions.question: Who is going to go swimming every day?
Who is going to tidy the garden?
Who is going to try to make new friends?
Who is going to cycle more often?
Who is going to start photography classes?
Who is going to eat more healthily?
